title: LOWER INSTRUMENT PANELS & STEERING COLUMN COVER
summary: Lower instrument panel trim pads (the LH pad around the speedometer/tach and steering column, and the RH dash pad over the glove-box area) and the steering column cover under the column, all models. The pads are screwed into U-nuts on the dash structure, the RH pad through painted eyelets, with a special clip at its RH end (View A); the column cover is screwed to the LH pad and up into a grommet at the column (View B).
